create_word_pulse_feature: create a WordPulse feature that generates a short burst of 1s on word start with configurable duration
create_phoneme_pulse_feature: create a PhonemePulse feature that marks phoneme change boundaries with configurable pulse length
create_word_hash_feature: create a WordHash feature that returns a word hash distributed into optional buckets for prediction
create_word_frequency_feature: create a WordFrequency feature that returns the Zipf frequency of a word for a given language
create_modality_feature: create a Modality feature that returns a categorical value for audio or visual word stimulus
